chapter: Family, Margaret's story and Eutris's memories
title: Arriving in New York in September 1928 and joining Luis Russell
summary: He came to visit his mother from Buffalo, where he played in Jimmy Harrison's band, and got a job with Luis Russell.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: When did you first come to New York?
I came to New York September the 8th, 1928, and got a job on (1928.)
playing up here with Lu Russell.
Was that the first time you had played with Louis Russell?
Had you heard of him before?
Never. I hadn't heard of nobody in New York. I came up here to visit my mother. I was playing with Jimmy Harrison in Buffalo and I came from Buffalo to visit my mother here and that was on a Sunday.
You worked with Jimmy Harrison in Buffalo before you came to New York?
Which band was this in Buffalo that you were playing with, with Jimmy Harrison?
That was his band. He played piano, not trombone. No, no, he didn't play trombone.
